insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: ₹ XXXX (Individual Sum Insured or Floater Sum Insured as per policy)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Reset Benefit – The Sum Insured will be reset up to 100% once a policy year for same illness and Unlimited times for different illness
great.explanation: The Sum Insured resets once per policy year for the same illness and unlimited times for different illnesses. This means your coverage can replenish frequently, reducing risk of running out of cover.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: Loyalty Bonus- A Get a 20% loyalty bonusof the Annual Sum Insured, up to a max of 100%... No reduction to the cumulative bonus even in case of a claim.
great.explanation: You earn a loyalty bonus up to 100% of the Sum Insured that does not reduce after claims. This rewards claim-free years and maintains your coverage even after claims.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: Sum Insured Protector – Protects the sum insured against the rising inflation by linking the Sum insured under the base plan to the consumer price index (CPI).
great.explanation: If chosen, your Sum Insured increases with inflation by linking to the CPI. This helps your coverage keep pace with rising healthcare costs over time.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Claim Protector - If claim has been accepted under “Inpatient treatment” or “Daycare procedure”, then items which are included in the list of excluded items not payable in that particular claim will become payable up to the Annual Sum Insured under the policy.
great.explanation: Opting for Claim Protector makes normally excluded consumables payable up to the Sum Insured for inpatient or daycare claims. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses on such items.

good.name: Room Rent
good.reference: Policy Coverage i.Basic Covers: 1; also repeated under Financial limits of coverage
good.explanation: Room rent is limited to a single private room. This is a common standard providing decent comfort but not unlimited room choice.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Pre Hospitalization Medical expenses  - 60 days before hospitalization
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered. This helps cover related costs leading to hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses –180 days after discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered. This supports recovery costs after hospital treatment.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre -existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Exclusions i. Standard Exclusion 1. Code- Excl01- Pre-Existing Diseases
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months from policy start. After that, they are covered, which is standard industry practice.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses for listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage post first policy inception.
good.reference: Exclusions i. Standard Exclusion 2. Code- Excl02
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period before coverage begins. This is a typical waiting period.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Initial waiting period: 30 days for all illnesses (except hospitalization due to injury)
good.reference: Waiting period section; also Excl03-30-day waiting period
good.explanation: Illness claims are not covered in the first 30 days, but accidents are covered immediately. This is standard in the market.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Domestic Air Ambulance Cover  - Covers expenses during emergencies up to the annual Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Air ambulance expenses for emergencies are covered up to the Sum Insured. This provides valuable support during critical transport.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: * 2 years after policy inception, the maximum liability arising out of any Claim from a cataract treatment claim shall be restricted to up to 10% of the Annual Sum Insured subject to a maximum of ₹1 Lakh per eye.
bad.reference: List of specific diseases/procedure (Cataract note); also repeated under Financial limits of coverage
bad.explanation: Cataract treatment has a sub-limit of 10% of Sum Insured or ₹1 lakh per eye, which may increase your out-of-pocket costs if hospital bills exceed this cap.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-medical and non-payable expenses are your responsibility.
bad.explanation: Consumables and non-payable items are not covered by default, meaning you pay out-of-pocket unless you opt for Claim Protector.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote:
Voluntary co-payment opted- XX% will be applicable for each and every claim

Zone Based Pricing – Premium depends on your chosen zone. If treatment is conducted in a higher zone, co-payment applies.
bad.reference: Financial limits of coverage (Co-payment; Zone Based Pricing); also Optional Covers: Voluntary Co-payment
bad.explanation: The policy mentions voluntary and zone-based co-pays, which means you may have to pay a percentage of each claim depending on your zone and choices. Any co-pay clause is considered a negative feature.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Find our extensive list of hospitals providing cashless services on our website https://www.icicilombard.com/health-insurance/health-claim/partner-hospital or on the IL TakeCare App.
unclear.explanation: The policy does not specify the size of the cashless hospital network. You should verify the current network size and availability in your area before purchase.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
